outcome: Composite cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization

quotes.quote: we selected 17 studies involving a total of 61 489 participants
The composite CV outcome in patients with HFrEF was available in 10 trials.
three trials comparing ARNI with RASi.
At present, there are still no published or ongoing trials directly comparing the CV outcomes of these drugs.

scope.reading: Ji 2023 is a network meta-analysis of SGLT2 inhibitors, RAS inhibitors and ARNI in heart failure: its 17 studies span HFrEF and HFpEF and three treatment classes, so the network-wide 17 is not the target. Its HFrEF composite (CV death or HHF) has 10 trials, cited as one list (enumerated above). Only three of its trials compare ARNI with a RAS inhibitor directly -- PARADIGM-HF, PARALLEL-HF and PARAGON-HF (reference 10, an HFpEF trial) -- so the direct sacubitril/valsartan-versus-RASi evidence in HFrEF is PARADIGM-HF and PARALLEL-HF: both of our trials. The other eight HFrEF trials compare SGLT2 inhibitors or RAS inhibitors with placebo and enter its estimate only indirectly. Our control stays a RAS inhibitor.
scope.reported_by: external review of the sacubitril-valsartan-hfref topic (28 Sep 2026)

method_difference.heading: Same direct trials, a different representation

quotes.quote: The comparison of different interventions was made using a frequentist approach for each endpoint.
Risk ratio (RR) and 95% confidence interval (CI) were assessed for the association between the intervention and the incidence of events.
Compared with RASi, ARNI significantly decreased the occurrence of CV death or HHF (RR = 0.83, 95% CI 0.77–0.89).

method_difference.reading: Its 0.83 is a network risk ratio of event proportions, combining the two direct trials with indirect evidence through placebo; we pool time-to-event hazard ratios from the same two direct trials (PARADIGM-HF alone reports HR 0.80, 0.73 to 0.87). The two numbers are different representations of largely the same randomised evidence, so agreement near 0.83 is not validation and not an independent result. Its abstract attributes the same RR and CI to a comparison with placebo (COMPARATOR_INTERNAL_MISMATCH, recorded separately); the main text's RAS-inhibitor comparison is the one shown beside our result.
method_difference.reported_by: external review of the sacubitril-valsartan-hfref topic (28 Sep 2026)
